# Training and serving capability matrix

<!-- Generated by scripts/gates/training-capabilities.py from scripts/gates/training-capabilities.tsv; edit the declaration, not this page. -->

Which architecture can be fine-tuned how, over which checkpoint precision,
and served with adapters and which KV tiers, and which serving contracts each
served architecture is certified for. Every cell names the test that
backs it; a cell with no test is written `-` and means "not offered", never
"untested but probably works". Per-model pages hold the commands. This page
does not record speed or memory figures.

Tests are named `crate/tests/file.rs::test_name` (or `crate/src/file.rs` for a
unit test). A test that needs a real checkpoint or a CUDA card is marked
`(real)` or `(cuda)`; the others run on the CPU backend with random weights.
`gpt2` trains from scratch (see its page) and offers no adapter.

or the expert banks LAYER-STREAMED (weights=f32|bf16,window=N): built straight into a window of f32 slots from the stored banks, the released 26B's NVFP4/MXFP8 banks dequantized once into bf16 values under an f32 master with the AdamW state on the host or in a state file, the core's bank gradients carried across its passes, the banks saved in their stored encoding and served as bf16, exact resume through the fit loop; | `glmdsa` | fp32 weights; AdamW state on the device in f32, bf16 or int8 blocks, or in host memory in any format with exact resume (the run's precision, through the generic optimizer-state path); routed experts hold their routed rows only; activations=recompute keeps one layer's activations and replays each layer before its backward, activations=bf16|fp8 also holds the residuals narrow: `glmdsa/tests/it/convergence.rs::glm_overfits_fixed_batch`, `glmdsa/tests/it/optimizer_state.rs::glm_trains_with_narrow_optimizer_state`, `glmdsa/tests/it/optimizer_state.rs::glm_resumes_exactly_with_host_moments`, `glmdsa/tests/it/recompute.rs::glm_recomputes_every_layer_and_narrows_its_boundaries` | - | - | - | - | - | - |
| `gpt2` | - | - | - | - | - | - | trains from scratch over a char/BPE corpus through the shared `model::train::fit` loop (no checkpoint to fine-tune, no adapters); activations=recompute keeps one layer's activations and replays each layer before its backward, activations=bf16|fp8 also holds the residuals narrow; weights=f32,window=N streams the layers through a device window with their values and optimizer state on the host, exact resume: `gpt2/tests/it/convergence.rs::engine_memorizes_cyclic_sequence`, `gpt2/tests/it/convergence.rs::engine_learns_copy_through_mask`, `gpt2/tests/it/convergence.rs::loss_improves_with_model_size`, `gpt2/tests/it/recompute.rs::gpt2_recomputes_every_layer_and_narrows_its_boundaries`, `gpt2/tests/it/layer_streamed.rs::gpt2_streams_its_layers_through_a_one_layer_window_and_resumes_exactly` |

No architecture offers a full fine-tune over a quantized or fp8 base. Trainable
parameters, gradients and optimizer moments are held below fp32 only where a
cell says so.

## Serving certification

Being registered does not establish that a model serves correctly. One row
per architecture the catalog serves; a cell names the tests that certify it,
and `-` means not certified.

- **Import:** loading validates the checkpoint: full tensor coverage, and a
  missing, unexpected or misshapen tensor or a bad format refused by name.
- **Forward parity:** the forward agrees numerically with an independent
  reference (a golden from `tools/goldens`, or a torch or transformers
  reference), not with another brain path.
- **Serve:** the model loads, generates (streaming where its action streams)
  and is released through its provider or resident; a scheduler engine also
  passes `model::serve::conformance::run_all`.
- **Cancel:** a token fired before the call is refused before any work (the
  catalog proof `catalog/tests/it/cancellation.rs`), or the family's own
  cancellation test.
- **Batch:** requests served together answer what each answers alone.
- **Quantized:** an int8, FP8, NF4 or packed serving tier tracks fp32 within
  the bound its test asserts.
- **Real weights:** a test over a released checkpoint, `(real)` or `(cuda)`.

**Support** is derived from the cells: `production` when forward parity, serve, cancel and batch
are all certified, `preview` otherwise.

## Checkpoint precision on load

| Source | What stays packed | Test |
|---|---|---|
| Q8_0 GGUF into int8 weights | the blocks are repacked, never expanded to fp32 | `flux2/tests/it/gguf_direct_int8.rs::gguf_int8_is_bit_identical_to_the_fp32_round_trip`, `model/src/int8.rs` |
| brain packed-int8 safetensors | words copied as stored | `checkpoint/src/weightio.rs::with_tensor_u32_chunks_is_memory_bounded` |
| FP8 HF directory into bf16 or NF4 base | nothing: each tensor is dequantized to fp32 on the host, one tensor at a time, then packed; a one-off bounded conversion into a packed file (convert_to_file) lets every later load preserve the NF4 bytes | `qwen35/tests/it/fp8_source.rs::streaming_the_whole_model_keeps_host_allocation_near_one_tensor`, `qwen35/tests/it/convert_base.rs::a_base_converted_once_equals_the_base_converted_on_every_load` |
| Other GGUF quant types (Q4_K and the rest) | nothing: decoded to fp32 and requantized to the requested tier; the packed relayout is tested but no loader uses it | `gguf/tests/it/kquant.rs` |
| Mixed per-tensor formats in one packed file | attention FP8, MLP NF4, embeddings bf16 and norms f32 in one file: every tensor reaches the device in its stored format (no fp32 expansion), the precision report lists each tensor's format and bytes, a fused group of differently stored parts converts per part under an explicit tier or loads as separate weights | `qwen35/tests/it/mixed_precision.rs::every_tensor_reaches_the_device_in_its_stored_format`, `qwen3/tests/it/mixed_precision.rs::every_tensor_reaches_the_device_in_its_stored_format`, `model/tests/it/upload_from_source.rs::a_fused_group_of_mixed_encodings_is_converted_per_part_or_split`, `checkpoint/src/packed/source.rs::a_fused_group_of_mixed_encodings_is_split_or_explicitly_converted` |

## Training correctness

Contracts every training run relies on, each held by the tests named beside
it against an independent reference (an FP64 oracle written from the math,
finite differences, or the uninterrupted run for a resume). A contract with
no row here is not certified.

| Contract | What holds | Tests |
|---|---|---|
| Loss and gradient at extreme inputs | the LM-head cross-entropy at logits in the hundreds in both tails, DPO's pair term at margins of hundreds of nats and GRPO's clipped term past its log-ratio cap equal an FP64 oracle written from the formula; finite differences hold the gradients | `model/tests/it/head_ce.rs::extreme_logits_match_the_host_reference_in_both_tails`, `model/tests/it/head_ce.rs::hidden_gradient_agrees_with_finite_differences_of_the_loss`, `rl/src/objective/dpo.rs::pair_term_matches_the_fp64_oracle_at_extreme_margins`, `rl/src/objective/grpo_term.rs::the_term_matches_the_fp64_reference_at_normal_extreme_and_boundary_inputs`, `rl/src/objective/grpo_term.rs::the_weight_is_the_derivative_of_the_loss_including_beyond_the_cap`, `rl/tests/distill_normalisation.rs::the_gradient_is_the_gradient_of_the_reported_loss` |
| The AdamW step | two steps with non-default betas, epsilon and decoupled weight decay move a parameter as a host AdamW does; device bf16 and int8 moments follow the host reference step; host offload and the cooperative clip follow the same scaling and clipping | `qwen3/tests/it/adamw_hyperparameters.rs::betas_and_eps_are_honoured`, `optim/tests/it/adamw_bf16_parity.rs::device_bf16_adamw_follows_the_host_reference_with_nearest_rounding_and_clip`, `optim/tests/it/adamw_q8_parity.rs::device_int8_adamw_follows_the_host_reference_with_nearest_rounding_and_clip`, `optim/tests/it/offload_parity.rs::scale_and_clip_follow_torch_on_device_and_host`, `optim/tests/it/coop_gradnorm.rs::cooperative_clip_coefficient_equals_the_f64_host_norm` |
| Token-weighted normalisation | a step that accumulates micro-batches, in turn or overlapped across a pipeline's stages, descends the per-token mean over all its supervised positions, records of unequal length included; data-parallel ranks are weighted by their supervised positions | `qwen3/tests/it/accumulation_normalisation.rs::sequential_micro_batches_descend_the_per_token_mean_of_the_step`, `qwen3/tests/it/accumulation_normalisation.rs::overlapped_pipeline_micro_batches_descend_the_per_token_mean_of_the_step`, `model/tests/it/distributed_model.rs::reduce_grads_weighted_gives_the_per_token_mean_of_unequal_ranks` |
| Exact resume | a run cancelled at a step boundary and run again ends at the bit-identical adapter, moments, digest and reported statistics of the uninterrupted run (SFT, DPO, distillation, GRPO stopped inside a group, the external policy gradient), and a run with other options refuses the state | `sdk/tests/it/chat_finetune.rs::a_cancelled_run_resumes_to_the_uninterrupted_result`, `sdk/tests/it/chat_finetune_qwen35.rs::a_cancelled_qwen35_run_resumes_to_the_uninterrupted_adapter`, `sdk/tests/it/preference_finetune.rs::a_cancelled_preference_run_resumes_to_the_uninterrupted_result`, `sdk/tests/it/chat_finetune_policy_gradient.rs::a_cancelled_policy_gradient_run_resumes_to_the_uninterrupted_adapter`, `rl/tests/objective_cursor.rs::a_resumed_dpo_run_continues_its_pair_stream`, `rl/tests/objective_cursor.rs::a_resumed_distillation_run_continues_its_example_stream`, `rl/tests/objective_cursor.rs::a_resumed_grpo_run_continues_its_rollout_stream` |
| The served artifact | the saved adapter and the saved full fine-tune, read back from disk into the family's serving engine, score the trained records at the loss the trainer measured on the model it trained | `rl/tests/it/served_conformance.rs::qwen3_serves_the_artifacts_it_trains`, `rl/tests/it/served_conformance.rs::qwen35_serves_the_artifacts_it_trains`, `rl/tests/it/served_conformance.rs::qwen35moe_serves_the_artifacts_it_trains`, `sdk/tests/it/chat_finetune.rs::a_fine_tune_exports_an_adapter_that_scores_and_serves` |
| Strict structured records | chat, rollout, teacher-context and preference records with a stray or missing field are refused by line and field, never coerced | `data/src/chat.rs::from_jsonl_rejects_an_unexpected_top_level_field`, `data/src/preference.rs::malformed_pairs_are_refused_by_line_and_field`, `data/tests/it/chat_teacher_context.rs::a_record_that_misstates_its_teacher_context_is_refused_naming_the_field` |
| The flow-matching batch | a FLUX.2 training batch, caption-only or paired, is the rectified-flow interpolant, velocity target and model time of the formula in FP64, with its references clean, and its target is the step the deployed Euler sampler integrates; the noise levels drawn are the ones the sampler visits | `flux2/tests/it/flow_batch_convention.rs::a_flow_batch_is_the_rectified_flow_formula_in_fp64`, `flux2/tests/it/flow_batch_convention.rs::the_velocity_target_is_the_step_the_euler_sampler_takes`, `flux2/tests/it/training_matches_deployment.rs::training_sigmas_are_the_schedule_the_sampler_integrates` |
| The logged method metrics | the KL, clip fraction and preference margin a run logs are the ones an independent forward of the same rows gives: GRPO's k3 KL to its reference and its clip fraction at both edges of the band, DPO's reference-normalised margin over rows of unequal length, the external policy gradient's KL to the reference it names | `rl/tests/grpo_fixes.rs::the_logged_kl_is_the_analytic_one`, `rl/tests/grpo_fixes.rs::the_logged_clip_fraction_is_the_one_the_band_gives`, `rl/tests/dpo_objective.rs::the_logged_margin_is_the_margin_an_independent_forward_measures`, `rl/tests/it/external_policy_gradient.rs::the_kl_term_is_the_k3_estimator_against_the_reference_it_names` |
| CPU and CUDA training | a LoRA run and a full fine-tune on CUDA give, step by step over three AdamW steps, every loss and trained-tensor gradient the CPU backend gives, within the binary32 round-off bound derived from the longest contraction and the reductions in series; the qwen35 fp32 LoRA tier likewise to the fp32 summation bound | `qwen3/tests/it/train_cuda_matches_cpu.rs::the_cuda_trainer_trains_lora_like_the_cpu_backend` (cuda), `qwen3/tests/it/train_cuda_matches_cpu.rs::the_cuda_trainer_trains_a_full_fine_tune_like_the_cpu_backend` (cuda), `qwen35moe/tests/it/train_cuda_matches_cpu.rs::the_cuda_trainer_trains_lora_like_the_cpu_backend` (cuda), `qwen35moe/tests/it/train_cuda_matches_cpu.rs::the_cuda_trainer_trains_a_full_fine_tune_like_the_cpu_backend` (cuda), `qwen35/tests/it/lora_cuda_matches_cpu.rs::the_cuda_fp32_tier_trains_like_the_cpu_backend` (cuda) |
| Held-out overlap is reported | a held-out set that repeats training examples (chat records, or preference pairs with both answers alike) is scored as given and the run reports how many it also trains on, in the outcome and the training record | `sdk/tests/it/chat_finetune.rs::a_held_out_set_that_repeats_training_records_reports_the_overlap`, `sdk/tests/it/preference_finetune.rs::held_out_pairs_that_repeat_training_pairs_report_the_overlap` |
| Image rows carry no target | records with image parts, read, encoded and prepared as a fine-tune does in every shape (whole, packed, per answer, thinking or not) and laid out by the loader the vision trainer reads, supervise no image-placeholder position and no placeholder token, and still supervise their answers | `sdk/src/finetune.rs::image_placeholder_positions_carry_no_target_through_the_dataset_path` |
| RLCD calibration | an RLCD run, with the published fine-tuning settings and as a pure policy gradient, trained against the exact posterior of a synthetic world, is calibrated on held-out draws: its ECE within 0.02 of the oracle's own finite-sample ECE, its NLL within 0.02 of the oracle's, while an overconfident scorer of the same ranking fails the ECE bound | `rlcd/tests/calibration_run.rs::an_rlcd_run_with_the_fine_tuning_settings_is_calibrated_on_held_out_data`, `rlcd/tests/calibration_run.rs::a_pure_policy_gradient_rlcd_run_is_calibrated_on_held_out_data` |

A LoRA adapter trains over an FP8 base on qwen3, qwen35 and ricursive. NVFP4
and MX checkpoints have `Weight` storage and execution, and only ricursive's
LoRA trainer offers the NVFP4 release as a base (its "Other" cell). The contributor roadmap for these gaps is
`.agents/roadmap/quantized-training.md`.
